name: Mandarin Chinese
blurb: Hear and read the four tones, then build HSK 1 and HSK 2 vocabulary and core grammar: measure words, 是, 有, 的, 了, 吗 and 呢, 不 and 没, 在, modal verbs, word order, and comparisons with 比.

sources.t: Chinese Grammar Wiki, AllSet Learning (A1 and A2 grammar points)
Chinese Pronunciation Wiki, AllSet Learning: tone change rules
HSK 1 Vocabulary, AllSet Learning Vocabulary Wiki
HSK 2 Vocabulary (exclusive), AllSet Learning Vocabulary Wiki
